provenance: Original synthetic LiquidBench Milestone 6 development fixture; not training or held-out data.
runtime_subset: Core Ruby Liquid with supplied hashes only; or static schema/reference contracts. No Shopify service emulation.
prompt: Repair only the JSON schema in sections/blocks-schema.liquid. Keep every byte outside its one top-level schema block unchanged. Strict JSON only. Exactly the following fields, array order and values are required; object key order/JSON whitespace may vary. Root fields: name Notes, settings empty array, max_blocks=3, blocks, presets. blocks contains exactly one definition: type note, name Note, limit=3, settings one text field id=text,label=Text,default=Note. presets contains exactly one named Notes, with blocks: first type note/settings text=First; then type note/settings text=Second. No other fields. Change only sections/blocks-schema.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
